ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: Which organism is the lowest in the food chain in this diagram?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The title in the figure is “Food Chain”. In the upper right there is the sun, and yellow light rays point to “phytoplankton” in the water. Red energy-flow arrows connect in order: “phytoplankton” → “zooplankton” → “small fish” → “mackerel” → “mahi mahi” → “large shark”. Reasoning: The organism at the lowest level in a food chain is the producer that first obtains energy from the sun; the sun itself is not an organism. The first labeled organism in the figure is phytoplankton, so the organism at the lowest level is phytoplankton.
